_about: Feat loop b4-crafting (2026-11-26). The owner: 'any feat that requires a crafting feat that
we removed, strip that requirement and allow it to be taken and reworked to fit our systems.'
The prerequisite is dropped in rules/feats.py (_retired_prerequisites); the rework runs in code
the documents name. Cypher Magic's document stays in batch1-spells.json: its +1 caster level
reads every scroll, the ones scribed at the enchanting circle included.
create-sanguine-elixir: rules/sanguine.py, made at the alchemy bench (api/alchemy/sanguine).
cooperative-crafting: rules/cooperative.py, at all five world-class benches.
create-reliquary-arms-and-shields: rules/reliquary.py, at the enchanting circle's Bind.
